svg.title: Qist symbol, small-size variant
svg.desc: Qist symbol, small-size variant. 120 artboard, optical shift -4 in x, stroke 8, corner radius 22, segment gaps 12, lower-right arc omitted, tail ends x=116. Use at 16 to 24px. Final vector artwork: do not edit, recolour outside the two inks, or mirror.
